column1: # Iliad - Part 2 — naskah 18 (M24018): Lentine dilantik sebagai Mayor Mokosh, Vasily &
# Wulfgar bersiap kabur dari sel, dan Commander terbangun di tubuh seorang gadis kecil.
# Tetap Inggris: Yellow Zone, Lentine, Mangi Security, Omen Squad, Mokosh, Anjelie,
# Griffin, Commander, Kenny, Chiloveig, Wulfgar, Vasily, URNC, AR Team, M4, Paradeus,
# Helena, Melanie, Darture, Doll.
# Beberapa baris narasi di file game masih berbahasa Mandarin — ikut diterjemahkan.
(The scorching hot wind of the Yellow Zone poured in through the breach in the urban area, carrying the scent of ash, rust, and lingering gunpowder smoke.)
column2: (Angin panas membara Yellow Zone menyembur masuk lewat lubang di area kota, membawa bau abu, besi berkarat, dan asap mesiu yang belum hilang.)

column1: （沸腾的广场上挤满了人——像是一头又一头待宰的猪猡。）
column2: （Lapangan yang mendidih itu dipenuhi orang—seperti babi-babi yang menunggu disembelih satu demi satu.）

column1: （全副武装的曼尼安保士兵守住了每个出入的通道，确保不会有任何人从他们的视线下逃脱。）
column2: （Tentara Mangi Security bersenjata lengkap menjaga setiap jalur masuk dan keluar, memastikan tidak ada satu orang pun bisa lolos dari pandangan mereka.）

column1: （临时搭起的高台很简陋。）
column2: （Panggung tinggi yang didirikan sementara itu sangat sederhana.）

column1: （但兰汀并不在乎。）
column2: （Tapi Lentine tidak peduli.）

column1: (Buzz—)
column2: (Bzzt—)

column1: （扩音器里，一段短促而刺耳的电流噪声掐断了人群的嘈杂，望着黑压压的人头，她发觉自己似乎并没有预期的那样期待。）
column2: （Di pengeras suara, semburan derau listrik yang pendek dan menusuk memutus keriuhan kerumunan. Menatap lautan kepala yang menghitam itu, dia menyadari dirinya sepertinya tidak seantusias yang dia perkirakan.）

column1: （或许，是因为她尚未触及最终的目标。）
column2: （Mungkin karena dia belum menyentuh tujuan akhirnya.）

column1: —I, Lentine, Captain of Mangi Security's Omen Squad.
column2: —Saya, Lentine, Captain Omen Squad Mangi Security.

column1: ...will officially serve as the Mayor, Chief Executive, and General Military Commander of Mokosh.
column2: ...secara resmi akan menjabat sebagai Wali Kota, Kepala Eksekutif, dan Panglima Militer Mokosh.

column1: Effective immediately, starting now.
column2: Berlaku seketika, mulai sekarang.

column1: (After delivering her declaration, Lentine put away her emotions and walked down the steps expressionlessly.)
column2: (Setelah menyampaikan deklarasinya, Lentine menyimpan emosinya dan menuruni tangga tanpa ekspresi.)

column1: (Even though she was speaking so resoundingly just a moment ago, once she came off the stage, she became incredibly silent.)
column2: (Meski sesaat tadi dia bicara begitu lantang, begitu turun dari panggung dia jadi teramat diam.)

column1: ('Congratulations on becoming the Mayor of Mokosh. The Yellow Zone is probably going to see some big changes from now on.')
column2: ('Selamat sudah menjadi Wali Kota Mokosh. Yellow Zone kemungkinan akan mengalami perubahan besar mulai sekarang.')

column1: ('My goodness, Lentine, I'm so glad to see you looking so spirited. I look forward to working with you in the future.')
column2: ('Aduh, Lentine, aku senang sekali melihatmu tampak begitu bersemangat. Aku menantikan kerja sama kita nanti.')

column1: (—Everything is very noisy.)
column2: (—Semuanya sangat berisik.)

column1: (Lentine somewhat numbly accepts the incoming chorus of congratulations, shaking hands filled with various different calculations and intentions.)
column2: (Lentine agak mati rasa menerima rentetan ucapan selamat yang datang, menjabat tangan-tangan yang penuh berbagai perhitungan dan niat berbeda.)

column1: (Everyone is congratulating her, but for some reason, she can't even be bothered to put on a professional smile.)
column2: (Semua orang memberinya selamat, tapi entah kenapa dia bahkan tidak sudi memasang senyum profesional.)

column1: Ascending to the position of mayor at such a young age, and in an emerging city like Mokosh no less. Congratulations, Lentine.
column2: Naik ke kursi wali kota di usia semuda itu, dan di kota yang sedang tumbuh seperti Mokosh. Selamat, Lentine.

column1: (It's Anjelie, the representative sent by the military—she still has to give her some face.)
column2: (Itu Anjelie, perwakilan yang dikirim militer—dia tetap harus menjaga muka di depannya.)

column1: (Lentine nods politely and exchanges a few pleasantries with her.)
column2: (Lentine mengangguk sopan dan bertukar beberapa kata santun dengannya.)

column1: (She wasn't happy.)
column2: (Dia tidak senang.)

column1: (Anjelie was right, this could be considered the highlight of her career, but for some reason, she couldn't feel happy at all.)
column2: (Anjelie benar, ini bisa dianggap puncak kariernya, tapi entah kenapa dia sama sekali tidak bisa merasa senang.)

column1: (After leaving Griffin, she started from Mangi Security and step by step, climbed to the position of 'Mayor' today. Next, she could use the power in her hands to do even more things.)
column2: (Setelah meninggalkan Griffin, dia memulai dari Mangi Security dan setapak demi setapak mendaki sampai ke kursi 'Wali Kota' hari ini. Setelah ini dia bisa memakai kekuasaan di tangannya untuk melakukan lebih banyak hal.)

column1: This is clearly what I've always wanted...
column2: Ini jelas yang selalu kuinginkan...

column1: (Yes, this was clearly what she had always wanted.)
column2: (Ya, ini jelas yang selalu dia inginkan.)

column1: (For this, she had spared no cost. Whether it was conscience or morality, or her most cherished subordinates.)
column2: (Untuk ini, dia tidak menghitung biaya apa pun. Entah nurani atau moral, atau bawahan yang paling dia sayangi.)

column1: (Now, she had succeeded.)
column2: (Sekarang dia sudah berhasil.)

column1: (The one she hated the most, that always overly idealistic, stupid Commander, was finally dead. And at the same time, she had ushered in such a grand success. Doesn't this prove that she was right?)
column2: (Orang yang paling dia benci, Commander bodoh yang selalu terlalu idealis itu, akhirnya mati. Dan pada waktu yang sama dia meraih keberhasilan sebesar itu. Bukankah itu membuktikan dia benar?)

column1: (That's right, idealism cannot survive in this kind of world. She is right.)
column2: (Benar, idealisme tidak bisa bertahan di dunia seperti ini. Dia benar.)

column1: I am correct...
column2: Aku benar...

column1: (Lentine clenches her fists. There are too many people here, the weather is too hot, and the sticky smell of sweat floating in the air makes her feel uncomfortable all over.)
column2: (Lentine mengepalkan tangannya. Di sini terlalu banyak orang, cuacanya terlalu panas, dan bau keringat lengket yang mengapung di udara membuat sekujur tubuhnya tidak nyaman.)

column1: (That's right, the discomfort only comes from this.)
column2: (Benar, rasa tidak nyaman itu hanya berasal dari situ.)

column1: (She tries her best not to think about that question she can't figure out.)
column2: (Dia berusaha sekuat tenaga tidak memikirkan pertanyaan yang tidak bisa dia pecahkan itu.)

column1: (Why?)
column2: (Kenapa?)

column1: (Cold sweat drips down her spine.)
column2: (Keringat dingin menetes di tulang belakangnya.)

column1: （为什么？）
column2: （Kenapa?）

column1: (Even though she was right, and everything succeeded.)
column2: (Meski dia benar, dan semuanya berhasil.)

column1: (Why does she feel a strange emotion?)
column2: (Kenapa dia merasakan emosi yang aneh?)

column1: (Why can't she truly be happy?)
column2: (Kenapa dia tidak bisa benar-benar senang?)
（——Tit tit tit.）

column1: (Lentine looked at the name on the communication device, took two deep breaths, and calmed herself down.)
column2: (Lentine menatap nama di perangkat komunikasinya, menarik napas panjang dua kali, dan menenangkan dirinya.)

column1: Oh my~ Congratulations, congratulations, the new Mayor of Mokosh!
column2: Aduh~ Selamat, selamat, Wali Kota Mokosh yang baru!

column1: Do you want me to play an inauguration march for you? I happen to have a really nice one saved here—the Funeral March♪
column2: Mau kuputarkan mars pelantikan untukmu? Kebetulan aku menyimpan satu yang bagus di sini—Mars Pemakaman♪

column1: You didn't call just to send this kind of meaningless congratulation, did you?
column2: Kau tidak menelepon cuma untuk mengirim ucapan selamat tanpa makna seperti itu, kan?

column1: Whoa, putting on airs right after taking the throne.
column2: Wah, langsung berlagak begitu naik takhta.

column1: So cold, even though I'm sincerely congratulating you?
column2: Dingin sekali, padahal aku memberi selamat dengan tulus?

column1: (Lentine takes a deep breath.)
column2: (Lentine menarik napas panjang.)

column1: Weird—? It's clearly a joyous day, so why do you sound like someone owes you an adjutant and hasn't paid you back?
column2: Aneh—? Ini jelas hari yang membahagiakan, kenapa suaramu seperti ada yang berutang satu adjutant padamu dan belum membayarnya?

column1: You don't want to resign on your first day as mayor, do you? That would be too lame~
column2: Kau tidak mau mengundurkan diri di hari pertama jadi wali kota, kan? Itu terlalu payah~

column1: (At least listen to what she has to say before cutting off the communication.)
column2: (Setidaknya dengarkan apa yang mau dia katakan sebelum memutus komunikasinya.)

column1: (Lentine convinced herself of this.)
column2: (Lentine meyakinkan dirinya begitu.)

column1: Alright, alright, seeing your bitter face is quite pitiful, so I'll be merciful and give you an inauguration gift~
column2: Sudah, sudah, melihat wajah pahitmu itu cukup menyedihkan, jadi aku akan berbelas kasih dan memberimu hadiah pelantikan~

column1: Is there a situation with Kenny?
column2: Ada kabar soal Kenny?

column1: Ding dong ding dong! Correct, plus ten points!
column2: Ting tong ting tong! Benar, tambah sepuluh poin!

column1: The rescue surgery is a huge—suc—cess! Vital signs are as stable as can be, almost as stable as a completely delisted stock—!
column2: Operasi penyelamatannya sukses—be—sar! Tanda vitalnya stabil semaksimal mungkin, hampir sestabil saham yang sudah didelisting total—!

column1: Wait, is a delisted stock considered stable...?
column2: Tunggu, saham yang didelisting itu terhitung stabil...?

column1: Ah, whatever! Anyway, he'll be alive and kicking and ready to be discharged in a few days!
column2: Ah, sudahlah! Pokoknya dia akan hidup segar bugar dan siap keluar rumah sakit beberapa hari lagi!

column1: Are you happy? Are you surprised? Are you—moved?
column2: Kau senang? Kau kaget? Kau—terharu?

column1: (Even Lentine, who was currently engulfed in nameless fury and irritated to the extreme, couldn't help but relax her tense shoulders the moment she heard those words.)
column2: (Bahkan Lentine yang saat itu tertelan amarah tanpa nama dan jengkel sampai puncaknya tidak bisa menahan diri untuk melonggarkan bahunya yang tegang begitu mendengar kata-kata itu.)

column1: Remember to pick him up from the hospital on time, Mr. Mayor?
column2: Ingat menjemputnya dari rumah sakit tepat waktu, ya, Tuan Wali Kota?

column1: Hmm—oh right, right, let me give you a little ro♪man♪tic advice!
column2: Hmm—oh iya, iya, biar kuberi sedikit saran ro♪man♪tis!

column1: Remember to bring a bouquet of flowers when you go! Any—flowers will do! Even if you steal them from the roadside, it doesn't matter! Buying a bucket of popcorn is fine too!
column2: Ingat bawa sebuket bunga saat pergi! Bunga—apa saja boleh! Meski kau mencurinya dari tepi jalan, tidak masalah! Beli seember popcorn juga boleh!

column1: For an innocent little boy like him who's completely infatuated with you, even if you just gave him a foxtail weed, he'd be moved to tears—
column2: Untuk anak lugu sepertinya yang sepenuhnya tergila-gila padamu, meski kau cuma memberinya rumput ekor kucing, dia akan terharu sampai menangis—

column1: And then next time, they'll come running back to work their tails off for you again, hehe♪
column2: Lalu lain kali, mereka akan berlari kembali dan kerja mati-matian untukmu lagi, hehe♪

column1: (To avoid losing her composure and cursing in anger backstage at the inauguration ceremony, Lentine cut off the communication before Chiloveig's nasty laughter even finished.)
column2: (Demi tidak kehilangan ketenangan dan memaki karena marah di balik panggung upacara pelantikan, Lentine memutus komunikasinya bahkan sebelum tawa menjijikkan Chiloveig selesai.)

column1: (Everything went smoothly. At least, her cherished subordinates were still alive.)
column2: (Semuanya berjalan mulus. Setidaknya bawahan yang dia sayangi masih hidup.)

column1: (She forced herself to forget the question that had just annoyed her and focused on dealing with the inauguration ceremony.)
column2: (Dia memaksa dirinya melupakan pertanyaan yang tadi menjengkelkannya dan fokus mengurus upacara pelantikan.)

column1: Next up are those guys...
column2: Berikutnya orang-orang itu...

column1: Let me see... strange, where is it hidden?
column2: Coba lihat... aneh, disembunyikan di mana?

column1: (Waking up from a coma only to find a pair of rough, large hands groping and searching all over one's body is definitely not a wonderful awakening experience.)
column2: (Bangun dari koma hanya untuk menemukan sepasang tangan besar dan kasar meraba serta mengobrak-abrik seluruh tubuh jelas bukan pengalaman bangun yang menyenangkan.)

column1: Wulfgar, what, what are you doing?
column2: Wulfgar, a-apa yang kau lakukan?

column1: Mr. Vasily, you're finally awake!
column2: Tuan Vasily, akhirnya Anda sadar!

column1: Ah... the key! That key should still be on you, right?
column2: Ah... kuncinya! Kunci itu masih ada di Anda, kan?

column1: (Vasily rubs the back of his groggy head, looks at the tightly locked heavy metal iron door, then looks at Wulfgar, and instantly understands everything.)
column2: (Vasily mengusap belakang kepalanya yang pening, menatap pintu besi berat yang terkunci rapat, lalu menatap Wulfgar, dan seketika memahami semuanya.)

column1: Breaking out right after coming in?
column2: Baru masuk langsung mau kabur?

column1: Are we supposed to take a nap before breaking out like you did?
column2: Apa kita harus tidur siang dulu sebelum kabur seperti Anda?

column1: You really treat this dump like it's your own home.
column2: Kau benar-benar menganggap tempat busuk ini seperti rumahmu sendiri.

column1: ...Although the environment and smell here are indeed nostalgic, I was forcibly knocked out just now!
column2: ...Meski lingkungan dan baunya di sini memang membangkitkan kenangan, tadi aku dipaksa pingsan!

column1: Never mind all that!
column2: Sudah, lupakan itu semua!

column1: They are preparing to deal with us according to URNC laws. Any later, and neither of us will survive.
column2: Mereka bersiap mengurus kita menurut hukum URNC. Lebih lama lagi, kita berdua tidak akan selamat.

column1: How are things on the Commander's side?
column2: Bagaimana keadaan di pihak Commander?

column1: I don't know yet, I haven't seen him here either. So, we have to get out of here quickly.
column2: Aku belum tahu, aku juga belum melihatnya di sini. Jadi kita harus cepat keluar dari sini.

column1: Wait, after talking for so long you still haven't moved... You didn't lose that key on the way, did you?
column2: Tunggu, sudah bicara selama itu Anda belum bergerak... Kuncinya tidak hilang di jalan, kan?

column1: No. I have a lot of experience with rebellions, especially failed ones.
column2: Tidak. Aku punya banyak pengalaman soal pemberontakan, terutama yang gagal.

column1: (Saying this, Vasily took out the key to open the door from his person. He had once used this key to open a new path—and this path was exactly the one paved for him by the Commander who fought alongside him.)
column2: (Sembari bicara, Vasily mengeluarkan kunci pembuka pintu itu dari balik pakaiannya. Dia pernah memakai kunci itu untuk membuka jalan baru—dan jalan itu tepatnya jalan yang diaspalkan untuknya oleh Commander yang bertarung di sisinya.)

column1: Observe the situation, and act according to my instructions later. I know there's a hidden door nearby.
column2: Amati situasinya, dan nanti bergerak menurut instruksiku. Aku tahu ada pintu tersembunyi di dekat sini.

column1: Got it!
column2: Siap!

column1: (Suddenly, an unexpected voice interrupts their "prison break plan".)
column2: (Tiba-tiba sebuah suara yang tak terduga menyela "rencana kabur dari penjara" mereka.)

column1: You two, be quiet!
column2: Kalian berdua, diam!

column1: We're about to be shot, what's wrong with saying a few words?!
column2: Kami hampir ditembak mati, apa salahnya bicara beberapa kata?!

column1: Who are you... You're not from Mokosh?
column2: Kau siapa... Kau bukan dari Mokosh?

column1: (Vasily keenly sensed something was wrong.)
column2: (Vasily dengan tajam merasakan ada yang tidak beres.)

column1: (Previously, the guards in Mokosh, even when guarding prisoners, still retained some respect for him as their former leader. But in this prison guard's tone, there was only the coldness of strictly business.)
column2: (Sebelumnya, penjaga di Mokosh, bahkan saat menjaga tahanan, masih menyimpan sedikit rasa hormat padanya sebagai mantan pemimpin mereka. Tapi dalam nada penjaga penjara ini, hanya ada dinginnya urusan kerja.)

column1: (It seems the URNC has completely and forcibly overhauled the entire system of Mokosh from top to bottom.)
column2: (Sepertinya URNC sudah sepenuhnya dan secara paksa merombak seluruh sistem Mokosh dari atas ke bawah.)

column1: (This discovery made Vasily feel an even stronger sense of unease about the Commander's situation.)
column2: (Temuan itu membuat Vasily merasakan kegelisahan yang lebih kuat soal keadaan Commander.)

column1: You don't need to know my identity.
column2: Kau tidak perlu tahu identitasku.

column1: Why are you talking to her so much, Mr. Vasily.
column2: Kenapa Anda banyak bicara dengannya, Tuan Vasily.

column1: Hey, if you have the guts, just deal with us quickly and give us a quick death!
column2: Hei, kalau kau punya nyali, urus kami cepat dan beri kami kematian yang cepat!

column1: (Unexpectedly, upon hearing this, the owner of the voice seemed to gradually approach them.)
column2: (Tak terduga, mendengar itu pemilik suara tersebut malah berangsur mendekat ke arah mereka.)

column1: (It was the sound of high heels. The heels weren't high, likely a height just right for ease of movement.)
column2: (Itu bunyi hak tinggi. Haknya tidak tinggi, kemungkinan tinggi yang tepat untuk memudahkan bergerak.)

column1: We? Did I say I wanted a quick death too?
column2: Kami? Aku bilang aku juga mau kematian cepat?

column1: We have the key anyway, what's there to be afraid of.
column2: Lagi pula kita punya kuncinya, apa yang perlu ditakuti.

column1: ...Before I manage to open the door, you'd better keep your mouth shut.
column2: ...Sebelum aku berhasil membuka pintunya, sebaiknya kau tutup mulut.

column1: (The sound of those shoes drew closer and closer, until Vasily and Wulfgar finally saw the owner of the voice clearly—)
column2: (Bunyi sepatu itu makin dekat dan makin dekat, sampai Vasily dan Wulfgar akhirnya melihat jelas pemilik suara itu—)

column1: Don't worry, soon... things will develop just as you expect.
column2: Jangan khawatir, segera... semuanya akan berkembang tepat seperti dugaanmu.

column1: Prepare to face the judgment of justice. You already have no way out...
column2: Bersiaplah menghadapi keadilan. Kalian sudah tidak punya jalan keluar...

column1: (My last memory is of the AR Team desperately lunging towards me, and M4 finally catching me.)
column2: (Ingatan terakhirku adalah AR Team yang mati-matian menerjang ke arahku, dan M4 yang akhirnya menangkapku.)

column1: (Then came a dizziness that felt like it could squeeze my brain out through my ears, and an incredibly chaotic self-awareness—it seemed there was always a voice whispering unintelligible words to me.)
column2: (Lalu datang pusing yang terasa seperti bisa memeras otakku keluar lewat telinga, dan kesadaran diri yang teramat kacau—sepertinya selalu ada suara yang membisikkan kata-kata tak terpahami padaku.)

column1: (The world showed me twisted, cruel, and bizarre totems from other angles; it was a stage inhabited by some unacknowledged evil doctrine.)
column2: (Dunia memperlihatkan padaku totem yang bengkok, kejam, dan ganjil dari sudut-sudut lain; itu panggung yang dihuni semacam doktrin jahat yang tidak diakui.)

column1: (Without a doubt, this is a Paradeus facility—and I have been imprisoned by them. This feeling is both familiar and strange... and it's already good enough that I haven't felt any torture yet.)
column2: (Tidak diragukan, ini fasilitas Paradeus—dan aku dikurung oleh mereka. Perasaan ini akrab sekaligus asing... dan sudah cukup baik bahwa aku belum merasakan siksaan apa pun.)

column1: (But this doesn't help me understand the current situation. Paradeus hasn't put any restraints like handcuffs on me. Are they not afraid of me escaping, or is there another hidden reason?)
column2: (Tapi itu tidak membantuku memahami situasi sekarang. Paradeus tidak memasang pengekang apa pun seperti belenggu tangan padaku. Apa mereka tidak takut aku kabur, atau ada alasan lain yang tersembunyi?)

column1: Hmm...? But where... is this place...
column2: Hmm...? Tapi ini... tempat apa...

column1: (I found that I could still move freely. Turning my perspective, on either side of me were two incubation tubes that had once held Helena, each containing a petite girl lying inside.)
column2: (Kudapati aku masih bisa bergerak bebas. Mengalihkan pandangan, di kedua sisiku ada dua tabung inkubasi yang dulu menampung Helena, masing-masing berisi seorang gadis kecil yang terbaring di dalamnya.)

column1: (They look very much like Helena and Melanie, but they are not them.)
column2: (Mereka sangat mirip Helena dan Melanie, tapi mereka bukan keduanya.)

column1: (It seems Paradeus has finally become perverted enough to stuff me into a tank too.)
column2: (Sepertinya Paradeus akhirnya cukup gila untuk menjejalkan aku ke dalam tabung juga.)

column1: (And just as I was thinking, a familiar face walks over, startling me. She doesn't mind at all, seemingly used to it, and just slightly pouts her lips.)
column2: (Dan tepat saat aku berpikir, sebuah wajah yang kukenal melangkah mendekat, mengejutkanku. Dia sama sekali tidak peduli, sepertinya sudah biasa, dan hanya sedikit memberengut.)

column1: Tsk...
column2: Cih...

column1: (I watch as the third-generation Doll somewhat clumsily but very gently fishes me out of the culture tank and rinses me off.)
column2: (Aku menyaksikan Doll generasi ketiga itu dengan agak kikuk tapi sangat lembut mengangkatku keluar dari tabung kultur dan membilasku.)

column1: (Inadvertently, I see my own hands.)
column2: (Tanpa sengaja aku melihat tanganku sendiri.)

column1: (It was at this time that I realized the complexity of the situation.)
column2: (Saat itulah aku menyadari betapa rumitnya situasi ini.)

column1: (It was a pair of slender and tender hands, completely belonging to a young girl, about the same size as Helena's, or even smaller.)
column2: (Itu sepasang tangan yang lentik dan lembut, sepenuhnya milik seorang gadis kecil, kira-kira seukuran tangan Helena, atau bahkan lebih kecil.)

column1: (And these are also my most precious hands, which I can now swing freely and use to grab things.)
column2: (Dan itu juga tangan yang paling berharga bagiku, yang sekarang bisa kuayunkan bebas dan kupakai untuk menggenggam benda.)

column1: (—I couldn't help but let out a sound that made that down-and-out Darture stop in her tracks.)
column2: (—Aku tak bisa menahan diri untuk mengeluarkan suara yang membuat Darture yang sedang bernasib buruk itu berhenti melangkah.)

column1: 这是……怎么回事？
column2: Ini... ada apa?
